title: Plain (No Marker)
description: A list with its marker and its hanging indent removed, so the items sit flush on the text rail — live's `.list-404` (`list-style-type: none; padding-left: 0 !important`, sd-lsx-child/assets/css/custom.css), which is how the 404 page's suggestion list is drawn. Live bakes the leading dash into each item's copy rather than using a marker, so the rule only has to get out of the way. Use it where a list is a run of short labelled lines rather than a set of bullets; where a glyph is wanted instead, `is-style-list-check` hangs a tick in the gutter. The indent is cleared as `padding-inline-start`, not `padding-left`, because that is the property the UA stylesheet actually sets — clearing only the physical one would leave the indent in RTL. Neither declaration needs `!important` from `:where()`: nothing in this theme styles `.wp-block-list`, so the only thing to beat is the UA stylesheet, which any author rule outranks. Live needed it because it was overriding Bootstrap.
